mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity), 0) AS sales, COALESCE(SUM(oi.price * oi.quantity), 0.00) AS amount FROM oms_order o JOIN oms_order_item oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_message m WHERE m.role = 'user'
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(m.prompt_tokens, 0) + COALESCE(m.completion_tokens, 0)), 0) FROM ai_message m WHERE 1 = 1

SELECT t.product_id AS productId, (SELECT oi2.product_name FROM oms_order_item oi2 WHERE oi2.product_id = t.product_id ORDER BY oi2.create_time DESC LIMIT 1) AS productName, t.sales, t.amount FROM (SELECT oi.product_id, COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity), 0) AS sales, COALESCE(SUM(oi.price * oi.quantity), 0.00) AS amount FROM oms_order o JOIN oms_order_item oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE GROUP BY oi.product_id ORDER BY sales DESC LIMIT 10) t ORDER BY t.sales DESC
